name: su2
summary: CFD and adjoint optimization suite for aerodynamic analysis and engineering optimization workflows.
why_it_matters: SU2 preserves specialized aerospace and CFD capability knowledge, but there is no current scenario demand that justifies active resource maintenance.
when_to_use: A future scenario needs CFD or aerodynamic optimization.
Operators want adjoint-based design studies in local or containerized workflows.
The workflow depends on engineering solvers beyond lightweight simulation.

platform_support.notes: Containerized and host installs are possible, but HPC assumptions and solver complexity make support uneven and Linux-leaning.

prerequisites: Artifact storage and result review path
implementation_notes: Promotion should validate a narrow solver workflow with known cases.
Keep preprocessing, optimization, and postprocessing concerns separate.
Do not claim general support without tested case execution.
operational_notes: Validation should run a sample case and verify expected outputs.
Long-running jobs need explicit cleanup and timeout handling.
risks: Specialized scientific stacks become maintenance drag without active users.
Solver support claims are easy to overstate from install success alone.
